text:
Priya S.: urgent Q — senior engineer in APAC got an external offer with relocation to UK. Manager asked if we can do an out-of-cycle promotion + comp match to retain. Need steps for international hires (FX, tax, equity cliff).

Dylan K.: manager here. Candidate expects answer tomorrow. Can we do title bump + salary same week? They also asked for an equity sign-on with vest-start aligned to their contractor start.

Ruth H.: high level: we can do comp matches and sign-on grants out-of-cycle; promotions still require a Promotion packet and calibration. For international moves coordinate with Global Mobility and Payroll for gross/net.

Priya S.: forms and approvals?

Ruth H.: process: 1) Comp-only retention: submit CompChange (mark "international" and attach offer). Approvals: manager + comp lead. SLA ~48–72h. Effective date = next payroll if cutoff met. 2) Promotion+comp: submit Promotion packet (evidence: scope delta, org impact, manager attestations). Calibration required; if urgent request expedited review with People Ops lead and strong evidence. 3) Equity/sign-on: Comp drafts grant memo; local legal review may be required. Exec approval for grants above band thresholds.

comp-admin-bot: currency guidance: use payroll vendor spot FX on submission date and record rate in CompChange. Use local market band to determine target.

payroll-bot: payroll notes: payroll runs 1st and 15th. International relocation changes and gross-up calculations need 7 business days lead for accurate tax/gross-up. Retro pay possible with Retro Approval form; adds processing time. See https://intranet/payroll/intl-relocation

Dylan K.: equity cliff/backdate: they want vest start aligned to contractor start. Possible?

Ruth H.: backdating vesting is sensitive. If the contractor-to-employee transition is documented, Legal + Equity Ops may approve adjusted tranches; provide contractor invoice history and manager justification. Expect 3–5 business day review.

Priya S.: messaging guidance: if we do comp-only retention, we should not call it a promotion. Be explicit that this is a retention adjustment while promotion scope is evaluated. Document next review timeline.

Dylan K.: action items: 1) I will submit CompChange (international retention) + offer, 2) Comp to route to Global Mobility & Equity Ops if needed, 3) Payroll to confirm cutoff and FX, 4) Manager to prepare Promotion packet if pursuing level change.

Ruth H.: noted. Keep candidate confidentiality. Ping People Ops lead to request expedited calibration if necessary. Closing after CompChange submitted.
